title: .aieng manifest

source_mode.description: Optional source mode for packages created from imported STEP geometry, structured definitions, or a registered CAD/CAE converter (Phase 20).

model_id.description: Stable model identifier used across package resources.

units.description: Canonical engineering units for interpreting package resources.

resources.description: Typed resource index. Values are package-relative paths, lists of them, or nested maps of either to any depth.

created_by.description: Creation provenance for traceability; not engineering validation evidence.

description: Package-level index for a self-describing .aieng engineering model repository. The manifest identifies the model, units, typed resources, and provenance; future versions should also index validation state, visual mappings, and allowed-operation resources.
$comment: The manifest should help a general AI discover structured engineering meaning before calling CAD/CAE tools. Phase 0 keeps only the required minimal fields.

resourceValue.$comment: A leaf path, a list of leaf paths, or a named group of either — to any depth. Depth is not part of the contract: a solver run indexes its artifacts under a run id (`simulation.runs.<run_id>.<artifact>`), and a future producer may group deeper still. Both readers already walk to leaf strings recursively; the schema used to spell two levels out by hand, so the third failed validation while every consumer handled it.
